info.title: Bunkai TMS API
info.description: Bunkai TMS public API. Wraps Supabase auth, ATC authoring, and run execution behind a versioned `/api/v1` surface. Designed to be operated by humans, scripts, CI/CD, and AI agents.

tags.name: Tokens
tags.description: Personal access token issuance and revocation.

bearerAuth.description: Personal access token. Format: `bk_pat_<12-char-prefix>.<base64url-secret>`. Issue via `POST /api/v1/tokens`.

cookieAuth.name: sb-fmbpikzpkafptqximhxn-auth-token
cookieAuth.description: Supabase session cookie. Set automatically after the magic-link callback in the web app. Used for browser-driven calls.

code.description: Machine-readable error code. Branch on this value, not on `message`.

details.description: Optional structured details. For validation errors this is the ZodError issues array.

request_id.description: Echoed `x-request-id`. Quote this in bug reports.

ErrorEnvelope.description: Canonical error envelope returned by every `/api/v1` route on failure.

next.description: Root-relative path to land on after the OTP exchange. Defaults to `/projects`.

token.description: Raw PAT in the form `bk_pat_<prefix>.<secret>`. Shown ONCE in this response. The server only stores SHA-256(secret).

warning.example: Store this token now — it cannot be retrieved later.

name.description: Human-readable label shown in the token-management UI.

scopes.description: Scopes granted to this token. At least one required.

workspace_id.description: Restrict the token to a single workspace. Omit for cross-workspace tokens.

expires_in_days.description: TTL in days. Omit for non-expiring tokens. Max 365.

token_prefix.description: First 12 chars of the secret. Safe to display.

name.description: 3–80 chars, at least one alphanumeric. Slug is auto-derived; names mapping to a reserved slug (api, new, settings, …) are rejected.

warning.description: Present only when the resulting nesting depth is >= 5.

name.description: 2–80 chars, at least one alphanumeric. Path segment is auto-derived.

parent_module_id.description: Parent module id; omit for a root module. Must belong to the same project.

name.description: 1–50 chars after trim, unique per project (case-insensitive).
1–50 chars after trim. Unique per project, case-insensitive.
1–50 chars after trim. Unique per project, case-insensitive.
New name, 2–80 chars, at least one alphanumeric. Renaming rebuilds the module path and every descendant path. Mutually exclusive with `parent_module_id` — a rename cannot be combined with a move.

description.description: New description (max 500 chars). Pass null to clear it; omit to leave it unchanged. Mutually exclusive with `parent_module_id` — a description edit cannot be combined with a move.

parent_module_id.description: Move the module: a UUID re-parents it under that module (carrying its subtree); null moves it to the project root; omit to leave the parent unchanged. Rejects cycles, depth > 6, and cross-project targets. Mutually exclusive with `name`/`description` — combining a move with a rename/description edit returns 422 (`combined_update_and_move`).

archived.description: Per-table counts of rows archived by the cascade.

description.description: Optional Markdown, up to 50 KB. Sanitized on save.

external_id.description: Optional Jira key (LETTERS-NUMBER, e.g. BK-42). Unique per project, case-insensitive.

description.description: Markdown, up to 50 KB; null clears it.

external_id.description: Jira key. Immutable once set — a change returns 409.

status.description: Ready-to-test gate: moving to ready_to_test with zero active acceptance criteria returns 409 (BK-15).

description.description: Optional Markdown, up to 50 KB. Sanitized on save.

position.description: 1-based insert position; appended at the tail when omitted. Active siblings shift down atomically.

description.description: Markdown, up to 50 KB; null clears it.

position.description: 1-based target position. The active set is re-numbered contiguously around it (no gaps).

jql.description: Jira JQL. Issues are imported into the project; components route to Modules by name (else Inbox).

slug.description: `<module-slug>/atc-<8 hex>`. Computed once at creation, immutable across edits.

version.description: Monotonic per ATC. Starts at 1, +1 per edit.

title.description: Optional title for the copy. Omit to default to `<source> (copy)`.

count.description: Number of distinct Tests that chain this ATC.

title.description: The Test title (Tests have no slug — ordered by title asc).

positions.description: Ascending positions the ATC occupies in this Test.

position.description: 1-based position in the chain; follows `atc_ids` array order verbatim.

atc_id.description: Chained ATC reference — a reference, never a copy.

title.description: Trimmed before validation; 1–200 chars after trim.

atc_ids.description: Ordered chain, ≥1. Duplicates are legal — a chain is a sequence, not a set. No server-side length cap.

workspace_id.description: Required for token-authenticated (Bearer) callers. Cookie sessions default to the active workspace at the submit instant.

atc_count.description: Number of ATCs in the chain (= count of `test_steps`).

atcs.description: The chain of ATCs, ordered by `test_steps.position`.

position.description: Position of this ATC in the Test chain (1..n, from `test_steps.position`).

step_ids.description: The COMPLETE new order as test_steps.id values — a permutation of the Test's current steps. step_id (not atc_id) is the handle because a chain may repeat an atc_id. Non-empty and free of duplicates.

tags.description: The COMPLETE new tag set — assigning replaces the whole set; an empty array clears all tags. Reserved tags (smoke/sanity/regression) are lowercased; custom tags preserve casing. Server normalizes (trim, dedupe) and rejects commas, >50 chars, or >20 tags.

test_title.description: Snapshot of the Test title at start.

atcs.description: The snapshot chain, ordered by position.

replayed.description: true when this call returned an existing Run within the 24h same-token window (HTTP 200); false/absent when freshly created (HTTP 201).

atc_id.description: Provenance link to the source ATC; SET NULL if the source is deleted.

atc_title.description: Snapshot of the ATC title at start.

atc_step_id.description: Provenance link to the source atc_steps row; SET NULL if the source is deleted. Never read for content.

content.description: Snapshot of atc_steps.content at start — frozen; later Test edits never alter it.

environment_id.description: A configured project_environments row belonging to the Test's Project.

executor_mode.description: Cookie sessions are always `human` (any supplied value is ignored). Bearer (PAT) callers may declare `agent` / `ci`; defaults to `human`.

start_token.description: Domain idempotency token (distinct from the Idempotency-Key header). A same (test_id, start_token) within 24h returns the existing Run (HTTP 200). Omit it to mint a fresh one server-side (always a new Run).

post.summary: Email-first routing probe
post.description: Returns whether an email is registered and whether it has been confirmed, so the login UI can route to the password, verify, or create step. Deliberately reveals existence (see ADR-0005 enumeration tradeoff); the real auth endpoints stay enumeration-safe.

post.summary: Verify email OTP → session + auto-minted PAT
post.description: Completes a verification-first sign-up by verifying the 6-digit email OTP. On success it establishes the Supabase session AND mints a fresh Bearer PAT in a single response — the same shape as POST /api/v1/auth/signin — so a new account can immediately authenticate subsequent requests.

post.summary: Send a Supabase magic-link email
post.description: Server-side wrapper around `supabase.auth.signInWithOtp`. Sends a one-time link to the supplied email. Public — no auth required.

429.description: Supabase OTP rate limit hit (free tier: 4/hour/email).

post.summary: Headless password sign-in + auto-minted PAT
post.description: Password sign-in for CLI / agent callers. Returns the Supabase session AND a freshly-minted Bearer PAT in a single response so the caller can immediately authenticate subsequent requests without a browser.

post.summary: Sign up + send 6-digit email verification
post.description: Registers an email + password account via the public sign-up path, which sends a 6-digit confirmation code by email. No session and no PAT are issued here — the account stays unconfirmed until the code is verified via POST /api/v1/auth/confirm.

409.description: Email already exists.

get.description: Returns service identity, current environment, and a server timestamp. Always public.
Discovery endpoint that points clients (CLI, agents, browsers) at the OpenAPI spec and the Scalar docs UI. Public.

post.summary: Issue a personal access token
post.description: Issuance is session-authenticated — a logged-in user mints PATs via the web app. PATs cannot mint other PATs (chicken-and-egg). The raw secret is returned exactly once.

201.description: Token created. Capture the `token` field — it is unrecoverable.

get.description: Returns every PAT the calling user owns, without the secret hash. RLS enforces ownership.

delete.description: Soft-delete: sets `revoked_at = now()` so the row stays in the audit trail. The bearer middleware rejects revoked rows.

404.description: Token not found or already revoked.

post.summary: Redeem a workspace invite token
post.description: Caller must be signed in. Caller email must match invite email. Adds membership in the invite's workspace + role; stamps acceptance on the invite.

403.description: Invite email does not match caller.

409.description: Invite already accepted / revoked / expired, or the caller already holds an equal-or-higher role (`already_member_equal_or_higher_role`).

post.summary: Set the active workspace for the current session
post.description: Validates membership, then sets the `bk_active_ws` httpOnly cookie. Supabase JWT is untouched.

403.description: Caller is not a member of the target workspace.

get.description: Returns the signed-in user, all workspaces they belong to, and the selected active workspace (driven by the bk_active_ws cookie).

post.summary: Create workspace + auto-enrol caller as owner
post.description: Wraps the `bunkai_bootstrap_workspace` SECURITY DEFINER RPC so the workspace row and the owner-membership row are inserted in a single transaction.

409.description: Slug already in use.

get.summary: List workspaces the caller belongs to
get.description: RLS-filtered list of every workspace where the caller has an active membership.

404.description: Workspace not found or not visible.

patch.description: Owner-only. Today only `name` is mutable; slug rotation is post-MVP.

403.description: Caller is not an owner.

post.summary: Issue a workspace invite
post.description: Admin/owner only. Generates a one-time token; returns the raw token + accept_url in the body. MVP does not send an email — share the URL out-of-band.

403.description: Caller is not an admin/owner.

409.description: Email already belongs to an active member (`email_already_member`) or a pending invite exists (`invite_already_pending`).

get.description: RLS limits results to admins/owners of the workspace.

post.summary: Rotate (resend) a workspace invite token
post.description: Generates a new secret + extends expiry by 7 days. Clears any prior acceptance/revocation. Admin/owner only via RLS.

404.description: Invite not found or no permission.
Invite not found or no permission.

post.summary: Create a project in a workspace
post.description: Member-only (role >= member). Auto-derives a per-workspace-unique slug from the name. Duplicate slug returns 409; non-members return 403.

400.description: Malformed workspace id or invalid JSON body.

403.description: Caller is not a member of the workspace.

409.description: A project with this slug already exists in the workspace.

422.description: Validation failed (including names that map to a reserved slug).

post.summary: Create a module in a project
post.description: Member-only (role >= member). Auto-derives a per-parent-unique path segment from the name. Modules nest up to 6 levels; depth >= 5 returns a soft warning, depth > 6 is rejected. Duplicate sibling path returns 409; non-members return 403.

400.description: Malformed project id or invalid JSON body.

403.description: Caller is not a member of the project.

409.description: A module with this name already exists under the same parent.

422.description: Validation failed (name, description, depth, or parent).

get.description: Lists the project's environments ordered by name (ascending). Visible to any workspace member; a non-member receives an empty list.

post.summary: Add an environment to a project
post.description: Member-only (role >= member). Trims the name and enforces 1–50 chars. The name is unique per project (case-insensitive); a duplicate returns 409. Non-members return 403.

400.description: Malformed project id or invalid JSON body.

403.description: Caller is not a member of the project.

409.description: An environment with this name already exists.

patch.description: Member-only (role >= member). Same name rules as create (trim, 1–50 chars, case-insensitive uniqueness). The row id is unchanged, so runs that reference it keep referencing it. A collision returns 409; non-members return 403; a missing environment returns 404.

400.description: Malformed environment id or invalid JSON body.

403.description: Caller is not a member of the project.

409.description: An environment with this name already exists.

delete.description: Member-only (role >= member). Hard-deletes an unused environment. BLOCKED with 409 when one or more runs reference the environment — the response message states how many. Non-members return 403; a missing environment returns 404.

403.description: Caller is not a member of the project.

409.description: The environment is in use by one or more runs and cannot be removed.

patch.summary: Rename, edit, or move a module
patch.description: Member-only (role >= member). Renaming rebuilds the module path and every descendant path; `parent_module_id` moves the module (and its subtree) to a new parent or the project root. `parent_module_id` is mutually exclusive with `name`/`description` — a combined update+move request returns 422 (`combined_update_and_move`); send them as separate PATCH calls. A sibling/destination slug collision returns 409; a cycle, depth-overflow, or invalid target returns 422. An archived module reads as 404. Viewers/non-members return 403.

400.description: Malformed module id or invalid JSON body.

403.description: Caller is not a member of the project.

409.description: The new name or move destination collides with a sibling module.

422.description: Validation failed (name, description, combined update+move, or move: cycle / depth / invalid parent).

delete.summary: Soft-delete (archive) a module and its subtree
delete.description: Member-only (role >= member). Archives the module, its descendant modules, and the linked user stories, acceptance criteria, and ATCs in one transaction. Returns per-table counts. Archiving an already-archived module returns 409; viewers/non-members return 403.

403.description: Caller is not a member of the project.

409.description: Module is already archived.

post.summary: Create a user story under a module
post.description: Member-only. Anchors the story to the module, validates the title (3–200) and optional Jira key, sanitizes the Markdown description. Duplicate Jira key in the project returns 409.

403.description: Not a member.

409.description: Jira key already linked in this project.

422.description: Validation failed (title, Jira key, or description size).

get.summary: List a module's active user stories
get.description: Member-only. Returns active (non-archived) stories, newest first.

patch.description: Member-only. Title / description / Jira key. The Jira key is immutable once set (409 on change).

403.description: Not a member.

409.description: Duplicate/immutable Jira key, or ready-to-test gate (no active acceptance criteria).

403.description: Not a member.

409.description: Already archived.

post.summary: Add an acceptance criterion to a user story
post.description: Member-only. Inserts at the given position (or the tail), atomically shifting active siblings down so positions stay gap-free.

403.description: Not a member.

get.summary: List a story's active acceptance criteria
get.description: Member-only. Returns active (non-archived) criteria in position order.

patch.summary: Edit or reorder an acceptance criterion
patch.description: Member-only. Edits title/detail (direct update) and/or moves position (atomic, gap-free re-number).

403.description: Not a member.

delete.description: Member-only. Archives the criterion, closes the position gap, and drops the parent story out of ready_to_test when it was the last active criterion (user_story_reverted).

403.description: Not a member.

409.description: Already archived.

post.summary: Start an async Jira import
post.description: Member-only. Enqueues a one-way Jira import for the project and processes it in the background; idempotent on re-run. At most one active import per project (409). Returns immediately with the job id.

403.description: Not a member.

409.description: An import is already running for this project.

get.description: Member-only. Returns the job status (queued | running | completed | failed) plus per-run counts and per-issue errors.

post.summary: Create an ATC with steps and assertions
post.description: Bearer `atc:write` (or cookie session). Transactional create across atcs + steps + assertions + AC links. Validates that every acceptance criterion belongs to the user story and the module is the user story's module or a descendant in the same project. Emits an `atc.created` event.

403.description: Missing atc:write scope or not a member.

404.description: User story or module not found.

409.description: Slug collision (`slug_collision`).

get.summary: Search ATCs by title and tags
get.description: Bearer `atc:read` (or cookie session). Project-scoped full-text search over ATC title + tags, ranked by relevance with a 7-day recency tie-break, optionally narrowed by a module subtree and/or layer. Results are restricted to the caller's active workspace memberships AND to the required `project_id`; a project outside those memberships returns no rows. Zero matches return an empty `items` array (never 404).

schema.description: Free-text query matched against ATC title + tags. Single token is prefix-aware (autocomplete); multiple words use AND semantics.

parameters.description: Free-text query matched against ATC title + tags. Single token is prefix-aware (autocomplete); multiple words use AND semantics.
parameters.name: query

schema.description: Required. Scopes the search to a single project; a project outside the caller's active workspaces returns no rows.

parameters.description: Required. Scopes the search to a single project; a project outside the caller's active workspaces returns no rows.
parameters.name: project_id

schema.description: Narrow results to this module and its descendant subtree.

parameters.description: Narrow results to this module and its descendant subtree.
parameters.name: module_id

403.description: Missing atc:read scope.

422.description: Validation failed (empty/missing query, missing/invalid project_id, bad limit, bad layer).

patch.summary: Edit an ATC (full replace of steps and assertions)
patch.description: Bearer `atc:write` (or cookie session). PUT-style full replace — omitted children are cleared. An empty body is a 200 no-op (no version bump, no event). `user_story_id`, `module_id`, and `slug` are immutable. Emits an `atc.updated` event with `affected_test_ids` (empty in the MVP).

parameters.name: X-If-Match
parameters.description: Current version for optimistic locking. A mismatch returns 409. Uses a custom header instead of RFC 7232 `If-Match` because the Vercel edge intercepts `If-Match` and rewrites the response to 412 (BK-96); `If-Match` is still accepted as a fallback on non-Vercel deployments.

200.description: ATC updated (or no-op for an empty body).

403.description: Missing atc:write scope or not a member.

409.description: Version conflict (code `conflict`, `details.reason: version_conflict`).

post.summary: Duplicate an ATC (deep-copy steps, assertions, AC bindings)
post.description: Bearer `atc:write` (or cookie session). Deep-copies the source ATC into a NEW ATC in the same project — every step and assertion (in order) plus the AC bindings — with a fresh slug, `version = 1`, and an independent set of child rows (editing the copy never changes the source). The title defaults to `<source> (copy)` unless an optional `title` is supplied. Emits an `atc.created` event.

403.description: Missing atc:write scope or not a member.

409.description: Slug collision (`slug_collision`). Retry.

422.description: Validation failed (`title_too_long` when the computed `(copy)` title exceeds 200 chars, or title/limits).

get.summary: Report which Tests chain an ATC ("used in N tests")
get.description: Bearer `atc:read` (or cookie session). Returns the distinct Tests that chain this ATC — each with the positions the ATC occupies — plus a `count` of distinct Tests, ordered by Test title. Results are confined to the ATC's own workspace (Tests are workspace-scoped) and the caller must be an active member of it. A reachable ATC with no chaining Tests returns `count: 0` + an empty `used_in` (never 404). A nonexistent, archived, or cross-workspace ATC returns a uniform 404 (no existence leak).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ATC to report usage for.

403.description: Missing atc:read scope.

404.description: ATC not found (also returned for an ATC outside the caller's workspaces — no existence leak).

post.summary: Create a Test by chaining ATCs
post.description: Bearer `atc:write` (or cookie session). Transactional create across tests + test_steps + activity log via one SECURITY DEFINER RPC. The Test binds to the workspace resolved at the submit instant: explicit `workspace_id` wins, else the cookie session's active workspace; token-authenticated callers must send `workspace_id`. Chain order follows the `atc_ids` array; duplicates are preserved.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Required. 8–128 chars, [a-zA-Z0-9_-]. A replay with the same key and payload returns the stored 201 snapshot; the same key with a different payload returns 409 `conflict`; a concurrent request with the same key while the first is still in flight also returns 409 `conflict`. Window: 24h.

403.description: Missing atc:write scope or not a workspace member with write access.

404.description: One or more selected ATCs are not available in this workspace (`not_found`). Foreign-workspace and nonexistent ids return byte-identical responses — no existence disclosure.

409.description: Idempotency-Key reused with a different request payload, or a request with the same key is still in flight (`conflict`).

422.description: Validation failed (`validation_failed` for title/uuid/workspace_id rules, `chain_empty` when the chain references no ATC).

get.description: Bearer `atc:read` (or cookie session). Returns the actor's workspace Tests that carry the given `tag` via a GIN containment match. Results are restricted to the actor's active workspace memberships — caller scope is ignored, cross-workspace Tests never leak. Zero matches return `{ items: [] }`, never a 404. The MVP exposes single-tag filtering only.

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: Required. The single tag to filter by. Normalized like stored tags (reserved tags lowercased), so `Smoke` matches `smoke`. An unused tag returns an empty list, never a 404.

get.summary: Read a Test with its chain of ATCs fully expanded
get.description: Cookie session or Bearer PAT (read identity only — viewer role suffices; no write scope required). Returns the Test header plus the ordered chain of ATCs, each expanded inline with its ordered steps and assertions, in one round trip. Live content (references, not snapshots). Non-disclosing: missing, not-visible, and foreign-workspace Tests all return an identical 404 — never 403, never an existence echo.

parameters.name: expand
parameters.description: Accepted for forward-compatibility; the response is always fully expanded in the MVP.

404.description: Test not found (missing, not visible, or foreign workspace — non-disclosing).

patch.summary: Reorder the ATC chain inside a Test
patch.description: Bearer `atc:write` (or cookie session). Rearranges the Test's ATC chain, preserving the exact step set (no add/remove). Body is the complete new order of `step_ids`. One SECURITY DEFINER RPC enforces the write gate, set equality, optimistic lock, no-op detection, and the atomic position rewrite. Submitting the current order is a 200 no-op — no version bump, no `updated_at` change, no event. A real reorder emits a single `test.reordered` activity-log event with `old_chain` / `new_chain` (atc_id arrays).

parameters.name: X-If-Match
parameters.description: Current Test version for optimistic locking (lenient — absent skips the guard). A mismatch returns 409 with `details.current_version` and `details.current_chain`. Uses a custom header instead of RFC 7232 `If-Match` because the Vercel edge rewrites `If-Match` to 412 (BK-96); `If-Match` is accepted as a fallback off-Vercel.

200.description: Reordered (or a no-op when the submitted order is unchanged). Returns the expanded Test.

403.description: Missing atc:write scope or not a workspace member with write access (`forbidden`).

404.description: Test not found / not visible — non-disclosing (`not_found`).

409.description: Version conflict (`conflict`, `details.reason: version_conflict`, with `current_version` + `current_chain`).

422.description: Empty chain or duplicate step ids (`chain_invalid`), or the submitted set is not the Test's steps (`chain_mismatch`, with `details.missing` / `details.extra`).

put.summary: Assign / replace the tag set on a Test
put.description: Bearer `atc:write` (or cookie session). Replaces the Test's entire tag set (PUT semantics — an empty array clears all tags). One SECURITY DEFINER RPC enforces the write gate, normalization (trim, reserved-lowercase, dedupe), shape rules (≤ 20 tags, ≤ 50 chars each, comma-free), optimistic lock, and no-op detection. Submitting the current set is a 200 no-op — no version bump, no `updated_at` change, no event. A real change emits a single `test.tags_changed` activity-log event with `old_tags` / `new_tags`.

parameters.name: X-If-Match
parameters.description: Current Test version for optimistic locking (lenient — absent skips the guard). A mismatch returns 409 with `details.current_version` and `details.current_tags`. Uses a custom header instead of RFC 7232 `If-Match` because the Vercel edge rewrites `If-Match` to 412 (BK-96); `If-Match` is accepted as a fallback off-Vercel.

200.description: Tags set (or a no-op when unchanged). Returns the expanded Test, now carrying `tags`.

403.description: Missing atc:write scope or not a workspace member with write access (`forbidden`).

404.description: Test not found / not visible — non-disclosing (`not_found`).

409.description: Version conflict (`conflict`, `details.reason: version_conflict`, with `current_version` + `current_tags`).

422.description: A tag exceeds 50 chars, contains a comma, or more than 20 tags supplied (`validation_failed`, `details.reason: tags_invalid`).

post.summary: Start a manual Run of a Test in a chosen environment
post.description: Bearer `run:execute` (or cookie session). Transactional create via one SECURITY DEFINER RPC: snapshots the Test's ATC chain into run_atcs/run_steps (each `pending`), validates the environment belongs to the Test's Project and that the Test has ≥1 executable step, and enforces a 24h same-token idempotency window. Cookie sessions run as `human`; PAT callers may declare `agent` / `ci`. Returns 201 on create, 200 when the 24h same-token window returned an existing Run.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Required. 8–128 chars, [a-zA-Z0-9_-]. The HTTP request-replay guard: a replay with the same key and payload returns the stored response; the same key with a different payload returns 409 `conflict`. Distinct from the domain `start_token` (the per-Test 24h window). Window: 24h.

200.description: Replay: the same (test_id, start_token) within 24h returned the existing Run.

403.description: Missing run:execute scope or not a workspace member with write access (non-disclosing — also returned for a Test the caller cannot see).

409.description: Idempotency-Key reused with a different payload, or a request with the same key is still in flight (`conflict`).

422.description: Validation failed (`validation_failed` for body shape, `no_executable_steps` when the Test has no executable steps, `environment_invalid` when the environment is not configured for the Test's Project).

get.summary: Read a Run with its snapshot chain fully expanded
get.description: Cookie session or Bearer PAT (read identity only — viewer role suffices; no write scope required). Returns the Run header plus the ordered run_atcs, each with its ordered run_steps — the immutable snapshot taken at start. Non-disclosing: missing, not-visible, and foreign-workspace Runs all return an identical 404 — never 403, never an existence echo.

404.description: Run not found (missing, not visible, or foreign workspace — non-disclosing).
